Based on my search, here are the best options for ordering birthday cakes online, depending on your location and needs:

## **International & US-Based Services**

| Service | What They Offer | Best For |
|---------|---------------|----------|
| **Bake Me a Wish** | Gourmet birthday cakes with personalized messages, overnight shipping, kosher & gluten-free options | Best overall - wide selection, reasonable shipping, no minimum order |
| **Goldbelly** | Cakes from famous bakeries (Carlo's, Ovenly, etc.), filters for dietary needs (vegan, paleo, gluten-free, kosher) | Famous/gourmet cakes, special dietary needs |
| **Milk Bar** | Festive, Instagram-worthy cakes | Fun, modern celebrations |
| **Harry & David** | Gourmet cakes for nationwide delivery | Premium gift cakes |
| **Instacart** | Same-day delivery from supermarkets, Target, Costco | Budget option, sometimes under $20 |

## **India-Based Services**

| Service | Coverage | Special Features |
|---------|----------|----------------|
| **IGP** | 400+ Indian cities, 100+ countries | Same-day, midnight & fixed-time delivery; photo cakes, theme cakes, pinata cakes |
| **FNP (Ferns N Petals)** | 350+ cities with 2-hour delivery | Same-day, express, midnight delivery; wide variety of flavors |
| **Midnightcake.com** | Across India | 3-hour delivery, candle-lit midnight delivery |
| **Cakingom** | India | Same-day delivery, international orders to India |
| **Flavoursguru** | Delhi/NCR | Large assortment of eggless cakes |

## **Other Regional Options**

| Service | Location | Highlights |
|---------|----------|------------|
| **The Hummingbird Bakery** | London only | Colorful American-style cakes, rainbow piñata cakes, personalization |
| **I Love Babycakes** | Hong Kong | Homestyle cakes, baking classes, DIY kits |
| **Vission Bakery** | Hong Kong | Custom orders, vegan/dairy-free options |
| **Brezze Gifts** | Philippines | Same-day delivery, Filipino & international flavors |

## **Tips for Ordering Online**
- Check **delivery areas** before browsing
- Look for **same-day or midnight delivery** if it's a last-minute order
- Consider **dietary restrictions** (eggless, gluten-free, vegan, kosher)
- Read **customer reviews** for freshness and reliability
- Compare **shipping costs** - not all services offer free delivery
